title: [main] Trial Balance (Excel) report shows incorrect figures and formatting differences compared to Trial Balance (Obsolete) report in Business Central v28.2
summary: Trial Balance Excel reports now correctly apply Global Dimension filters when generating figures, fixing an issue where department filters were ignored and aggregated data included excluded dimensions.
key_points: Codeunit Trial Balance now reads the Global Dimension 1 and 2 filters from the G/L Account request record
Dimension filters are applied with SetFilter on the query dimension columns, for both the ending-date and opening-balance passes
Fixes inflated totals when a department filter is combined with a date filter
Covers the standard, budget and consolidated reports that use the query-based path; by-period and prev-year reports are out of scope
Tests added for the Trial Balance Excel reports
quote: The Excel report collects its data through codeunit 4410 "Trial Balance", which builds figures from the aggregation queries
